conversation.text:
Description: In the Dining room, John Hobbes receives a call from Katherine. He describes the corpse at the scene and confirms Annie Beaumont is safe. The piano and thunder reappear, prompting him to leave the Dining room to go gather with the others.
Location: Dining room (Dining room)
Key Information:
  - John Hobbes answers the phone in the Dining room (Dining room) and speaks with Katherine (Katherine / Kate) on the other end.
  - Katherine calls looking for Martha Galley; upon learning John Hobbes picked up, she asks who he is and confirms the situation on site.
  - John Hobbes explicitly mentions during the call that there is a corpse in the Dining room, positioned at the head of the dining table, with spilled alcohol/wine around it.
  - John adds details: the curtains are drawn, and there appear to be bullet holes in the ceiling.
  - Katherine confirms she is Annie Beaumont’s mother and asks whether Annie Beaumont is safe.
  - John Hobbes confirms Annie Beaumont is currently safe and that he was with her earlier.
  - John tells Katherine there are five survivors on site and expresses confusion about the continuing incidents.
  - Katherine says she cannot come in person, but will contact nearby neighbors to help, and asks John Hobbes to keep everyone safe for now.
  - During the call, piano music is heard coming from the direction of the Living room.
  - After the call ends, another huge thunder-like sound is heard outside.
  - The narrator records that the piano is still playing; John Hobbes then leaves the Dining room to join the others.
  - The narrator notes the caller’s name might be Katherine or Catherine; the recorder uniformly uses the nickname “Kate.”
  - The narrator additionally mentions a game in the system called “Hangman,” and hints that it is not what it appears to be.
Characters:
  [John Hobbes (John Hobbes)] Person No. 1, the primary communicator and responder on site.
    · Answers the call in the Dining room and communicates with Katherine about the situation.
    · Describes the corpse’s position and abnormal details in the Dining room to the caller.
    · Confirms Annie Beaumont is safe and responds to the caller’s safety concerns.
    · After the call ends and the piano continues, leaves the Dining room to go gather.
  [Katherine (Katherine / Kate)] The caller on the phone, Annie Beaumont’s mother.
    · Calls looking for Martha Galley, then shifts to confirming the situation on site.
    · Remains calm after learning there is a corpse and says she will contact neighbors to help.
    · Asks John Hobbes to ensure everyone’s safety for now.
    · Shows strong concern for Annie Beaumont’s safety.
